title: Frontend Redesign — Implementation Guide (foundation-first, batch page rollout, verification battery)
source: Community-researched approach (Playwright visual snapshots, BackstopJS, strangler-fig/incremental design-system migration) + developer clarifications D11-D14 + Q&A 2026-11-23
applies_after: Developer picks the winning design (or a curated combination of both tracks) from issue #336 deliverables
core_principle: Foundation decided ONCE and built BEFORE any page. Pages picked batch-by-batch AFTER foundation is frozen. Pages can run in parallel AFTER a pilot proves the pattern. Never big-bang; never page-by-page without a foundation.

phases.name: Finalize design target (curation)
phases.when: After both tracks delivered + R1 comparison + developer review
steps: Developer picks winner OR curates a combination (e.g. Track B theme + Track A sidebar + Track B tables)
If combining: assemble the hybrid in design space first (Stitch/HTML, hours) — ONE approved target; never mix two references during implementation
Freeze the target: chosen theme(s), nav model, component styles, per-page source map (which track each page follows)
Record decisions as a new GitHub issue (foundation) per issue-first rule
phases.gate: Developer approves the single frozen target (design + per-page source map)

phases.name: Foundation (one-time, serial — NOT simultaneous with pages)
steps: Extract design tokens from the winning DESIGN.md -> CSS variables: colors (all 3 themes), typography, spacing (8px grid), radius, elevation, semantic status colors
Multi-theme support: theme sets as switchable variable blocks (dark primary per D13 + alternates)
Rebuild shared components in base template: topbar, sidebar/nav, cards, tables, buttons, inputs, dialogs, chips, alerts
Clean-minimal ethos encoded (D14): few colors, hairline borders, no decorative clutter, no pulsing/flashing
Touch targets >=48px, gaps >=8px baked into components (RD-09)
Component test-page: every component rendered in every theme

steps.detail: Static layout: build the chrome from frontend/confirmed/app_frame/ ONLY (app_frame_manifest.csv contract) — top bar/bottom nav/FAB are written once as shared widgets; no per-page chrome decisions.

phases.why_not_simultaneous: Pages consume the foundation. Starting pages first = each worker invents own tokens = recreates the duplicate-component mess being fixed.
phases.gate: Component test-page green in all 3 themes + existing pytest suite green + axe/Lighthouse a11y pass + developer approves

phases.name: Pilot page (serial — proves the pattern)
steps: Implement ONE representative page fully (recommend Dashboard — hardest layout)
Run the full verification battery (below)
Side-by-side vs the frozen design target at 4 viewports
Developer signs off — this locks the implementation pattern for the rollout
phases.gate: Pilot passes full battery + developer sign-off

phases.name: Batch page rollout (parallel allowed)
steps: Order by value: Dashboard -> Portfolio -> Watchlist -> Search/Holdings -> Goals -> Payouts -> Alerts -> Settings -> About/Share/Print -> remaining screens
Batch-by-batch: for each page the developer picks its source (Track A / Track B / combination) from the Phase 0 map
Multiple pages (or workers) may run IN PARALLEL — each in its own branch/PR, each against the frozen foundation
One page = one PR (project rule Q2); per-page verification battery must pass before merge
Foundation changes during rollout: STOP — re-freeze foundation first (never let pages fork the foundation)
phases.gate: Each page: full battery green + reviewer approval before merge; batch closes with full-suite run

phases.name: Android parity
phases.when: After (or parallel with) web pages once foundation exists
steps: Apply same tokens/components to Android screens
Device testing per Q8: install once, pm clear between runs, headed mode per Q10
Screenshot compare vs design target; touch-target audit >=48px
phases.gate: device_smoke.sh green + screenshots match + touch audit pass

phases.name: Cleanup
steps: Delete legacy CSS/classes/dead components (each removal confirmed per safety rules)
Remove old theme-switcher remnants per D11/OP5 decision if retired
phases.gate: Full pytest + whole-app visual sweep + zero orphan styles

per_page: 1. Existing pytest suite green (RD-01 functionality invariant — the guardrail through EVERY step)

2. Playwright visual snapshot: expect(page).toHaveScreenshot() at 4 viewports (360/768/1280/1920) vs golden images committed to git — any layout drift fails (https://playwright.dev/docs/test-snapshots)
3. Optional deeper diff: BackstopJS reference-vs-test report, approving changes like a design review (https://github.com/garris/BackstopJS)
4. Accessibility scan: axe-core / Lighthouse — contrast, roles, focus order
5. Touch-target audit: all interactive elements >=48px with >=8px gaps (RD-09)
6. Page journey smoke: the page's real flows still work end-to-end
7. Visual side-by-side vs the frozen design target (winning gallery HTML is the ground truth)
verification_battery.per_batch: Full pytest suite + aggregated screenshot diff run
verification_battery.final: Whole-app visual sweep + a11y + device smoke (Android) + developer acceptance
verification_battery.evidence: Each PR carries: screenshot diffs, a11y report, journey results — recorded in the issue

rules: Foundation BEFORE pages — serial one-time gate (Phase 1 cannot run simultaneously with Phase 3)
Pages IN PARALLEL after pilot — batch-by-batch, one page = one PR
Developer picks per-page sources batch-by-batch; the combination is frozen at Phase 0, not re-litigated per page
No logic/routing/DB/API changes — presentation only (RD-01); out-of-scope findings reported, never fixed silently
Multi-theme set stays (D14); clean-minimal is the quality bar (Zerodha philosophy); no-white primary per D13 unless developer reverses
Every merge: CI green + reviewer verdict + developer approval (Q9)

changelog.entry: v1.0 created — community-researched implementation roadmap + foundation-vs-batch clarification for the post-selection build of issue #336's winning design
v1.1 — D18 Flutter path addendum (stages F1-F5, issue #337); old-frontend implementation phases superseded
app_frame static-layout contract referenced in foundation phase (chrome widgets built once from frontend/confirmed/app_frame/)

flutter_path.decision: D18 (2026-11-24): frontend = Flutter (web+Android, single Dart codebase); backend engine unchanged behind JSON API adapter; old frontend (Jinja/static/Java-UI) removed FIRST then rebuilt from scratch; all designs/documents state Flutter as implementation target
stages: F2 JSON API adapter (engine untouched, tests green)
F3 Flutter scaffold + ThemeData (3 themes) + shared components
F4 screen-by-screen widget build from frontend/confirmed/
F5 cutover + retire old frontend + device smoke
flutter_path.supersedes_note: Phases 1-5 of this guide assumed Flask-template implementation; the Flutter path (D18) replaces that implementation route while retaining the guide's verification battery and batch discipline
